The twenty-participant/158-run inventory is a declaration; recording bytes, retained epochs, model payload identity and final-publication equivalence remain unresolved.

split.description: Shared oddball decoding uses six directional held-run folds:1357->2468 and reverse,1256->3478 and reverse,1234->5678 and reverse, with all-shape training and shape-specific test evaluation. The required Fig4C companion trains separately by shape; exact native producer/configuration parity remains unresolved. Sensor RSA uses original run-crossvalidation on reference epochs. None of these is a new held-shape or held-participant task.

inputs.description: Original MEG observations and source run/event/shape/rotation/scaling metadata, plus original reference stimulus/model RDM inputs. Shared and separate oddball analyses preserve reference-versus-outlier polarity; RSA uses reference epochs. Final input and permissible exposure manifests are not authenticated.

preprocessing.description: Preserve original bad-channel/Maxwell/SSS/filter/SSP/autoreject/resampling operations with authentic selection lineage. Pinned code250Hz/-100..1100ms and within-training-fold StandardScaler conflict with retained paper/contract -150..1150ms and per-epoch normalization. Shared decoder active direct-magnetometer input is unsmoothed; commented uniform_filter1d25 does not authenticate a published smoothed route. RSA uses virtual magnetometers and separate raw or Savitzky-Golay25/order2 branches. First-six-miniblock-trial exclusion precedes Epochs.selection for decoding; RSA reference selection does not inherit that filter.

metric.description: The primary is a source finding family, not one accuracy score: shared/separate shape/time ROC AUROC; participant-wise Pearson association with original behavioral shape weights and source cluster-selected shape profiles; signed run-crossvalidated crossnobis RDMs; separate symbolic and CORnet-S IT corr_cov trajectories with source temporal inference. These native quantities remain distinct. Larger AUROC is an ordered component result only; larger correlations, smaller p-values or shifted model peaks are not automatic family improvement.

aggregation.description: Retain source-native participant/run/fold/shape/time support. Shared AUROC averages six folds equally, then subjects equally; separate-training native producer parity remains open. Regularity uses all eleven shapes per subject/time, equal participant curves, source positive temporal clusters and per-subject means over their significant-cluster union. RSA retains55signed pairs and two separate model curves. Preserve source display SEM choices, full curves, variable cluster sets and undefined/NaN cases; no pooled family scalar, arbitrary norm or significance-only reproduction criterion is supplied.

full_panel.description: Complete approved sensor family: Fig4B shared and required Fig4C separate-training oddball/regularity analyses, both identifiable source smoothing branches, all twenty participants/eleven shapes/original runs, complete temporal representational geometry and separate symbolic-versus-visual model curves/inference. blocking_issues: This is a standalone corrected-primary family contract, not a mixed outcomes bundle against joint-AUROC improvement anchors. Figure4B remains legitimate within-family ordered evidence; component success cannot confer full-family reproduction/improvement. Paired primary outcomes and primary superiority remain unavailable under accepted scope.

All declared labels/shapes/time grids are supported pinned-code quantities, not measured authentic output manifests or final-paper identities. Code-grid -0.1..1.1s differs from retained paper/contract -0.15..1.15s; actual publication support must be reconciled. Each identity/dtype/reference/policy left null is genuinely unknown, not a hash of a shape or description.

Recover final-paper/code equivalence and complete source-native shared/separate decoding, regularity, geometry and model outputs. Accepted publisher evidence was search-index excerpts; frozen final-version fulltext was not authenticated. The modified decoder is grounded in retained source-lock/copy equality, not fresh upstream-byte recovery.

Authenticate all original20participants/158runs, raw recording/event/calibration/model inputs, actual retained epochs and preprocessing selection. Preserve early classification before rejection and reference-only RSA without decoder late filtering. No authentic observations or fitted model were accessed in this conversion.

Resolve source normalization/epoch/smoothing mismatches and the native separate-training producer/configuration. Source plot condition filenames establish required branch families, not authenticated branch generation. Raw versus Savitzky-Golay RSA and direct versus virtual magnetometers remain distinct.

Existing oddball scorer consumes supplied decisions; existing sensor-RSA component starts from processed reference epochs/models. Neither establishes raw preprocessing, authentic fitted-analysis replay, full source-vintage parity or independent whole-family verification. Source-specific granular output requirements are in GRANULAR_OUTPUT_DESIGN.json; no executable admission policy or fake required-output hash is supplied.

Independently derive all source outputs from authentic observations and frozen submitted analysis. Preserve full six-fold decisions/counts, native fit/selection lineage, complete shared/separate curves, every RDM pair/model value, actual cluster indices/p-values/statistics/null arrays, source display outputs and conditional peak reporting. Printed claims, copied curves, own-reported verified flags or hashes alone cannot establish computation.

Native null permutation arrays and actual permutation support/defaults/seeds are required granular derivation evidence. They are not reduced to an invented scalar or assigned an ungrounded distributional scientific comparator. The declared comparison class remains unresolved numerical-reference equivalence with no default norm, tolerance, target, every-cell decision or selected significance criterion.

Freeze source-specific full-family scientific criterion, support/missingness rules and participant-level dependence/multiplicity/uncertainty policies independently of derivation. Source NaNs from zero variance or empty significant-cluster unions cannot be silently dropped/replaced. Native cluster ordinal is not authenticated cross-run correspondence; cardinality/matching remain policy-unresolved.

V2 now represents the known indexed source quantities, so fixed-curve representation alone is not treated as scientific ineligibility. No generic scalar substitutes for full curves or55-pair matrices. All_References is not indispensable from code presence alone; source-space/fMRI/unrelated figures and historical prospective held-shape/variance-partition proposals remain outside the approved bounded family.

Original AUROC/source display sqrt19 with20participants, regularity/RSA sqrt20, r annotation as r-squared and conditional model peak reporting remain source facts or ambiguities, not default scientific criteria. A noise-ceiling algorithm absent from the inspected model script is not invented.

Authentic paired common-input/exposure/evaluator/computation/access/resource manifests and an independent verifier are absent. Public source/label history remains visible. No primary same-task superiority rule, AI result receipt, protected new test task or new canonical task hash is created.
